evidence.quote: Day-old loaves go to half price at two in the afternoon

observations.why: Allocates the day-old stock by price and time window, framing the discount as a proportional consequence of timing rather than rank or reciprocity.

evidence.quote: so the price is never a surprise at the till

observations.why: Frames the price change as a transparency and cost-of-choice matter for the customer; the 'as well' mirrors Ines's timing but the price framing carries the model.
